definition: This workflow family describes the procedure for determining the enthalpy and entropy changes of a first-order phase transition (solid-solid or solid-liquid) from calorimetric heat capacity or enthalpy versus temperature data. It involves detecting the transition anomaly in the thermophysical curve, defining a baseline representing the heat capacity had the transition not occurred, integrating the excess heat capacity or enthalpy jump with respect to the baseline to obtain the transition enthalpy ΔH_trans, and computing the transition entropy ΔS_trans either as ΔH_trans/T_trans or by integrating (C_p - C_p_baseline)/T over the transition region. Results are reported with measurement uncertainties and, for reversible transitions, compared with literature values where available.

tag_meta.verify_note: 通过比较计算出的ΔH和ΔS与文献值（或由Clausius-Clapeyron关系验证）的数值容差来判定复现是否成功。
tag_meta.lab_type_reason: 该工作流基于已有的量热数据（热容或焓）进行数值积分和基线选择，无需新做实验，只需纯计算即可复现。
